Kessler Werkzeugmaschinen
KX-500
5-axis machining centre
Operator and Maintenance Manual
Revision 3
For qualified maintenance personnel


1 Safety
1.1 General safety
Only qualified maintenance personnel who have read this manual may service the KX-500. Wear safety glasses and
cut-resistant gloves when you handle tools, chips and coolant. Never run the machine with the guarding open or a
safety device bypassed. Report damage to the guarding to your supervisor before you continue.
1.2 Lockout and tagout
Before you work inside the guarding or on the spindle, the tool changer or the coolant system, switch off the main
isolator and fit your personal lock and tag. Release the compressed air to the tool changer and the drawbar, and wait
until the spindle has stopped. Verify zero energy before you start, and remove your lock only when the work is
finished.
Kessler Werkzeugmaschinen KX-500 Operator and Maintenance Manual, Revision 3
Page 2

3 Troubleshooting table
Find the symptom, then follow the remedy.
Symptom
Probable cause
Remedy
spindle running hot and noisy at high rpm
worn spindle bearings
See 4.1 Replace spindle bearing set
(plant ref PROC-CNC-01)
See 4.2 Check spindle vibration from the HMI
(plant ref PROC-CNC-02)
coolant pressure dropping, parts coming out hot
blocked coolant filter
See 4.3 Clean coolant filter and flush lines
(plant ref PROC-CNC-03)
tool not clamping after change, machine stops
weak tool clamp springs or faulty clamp sensor
See 4.4 Replace tool clamp disc springs
(plant ref PROC-CNC-04)
Kessler Werkzeugmaschinen KX-500 Operator and Maintenance Manual, Revision 3
Page 4


4 Procedures
4.1 Replace spindle bearing set
Plant ref: PROC-CNC-01 | Lockout required: yes | Time: 240 min
WARNING: Apply lockout and tagout before starting. Verify zero energy.
1. Stop the machine, apply lockout and tagout on the main isolator, and verify zero energy.
 2. Remove the spindle cover and disconnect the drawbar and coolant lines.
 3. Extract the spindle cartridge with the puller and mount it on the bench.
 4. Press out both bearings and fit the new BRG-7014-ACD pair with the spacer.
 5. Fit a new SEAL-SPDL-70 front seal and pack the bearings with GREASE-KLB-2.
 6. Refit the cartridge, run the 20-minute warm-up cycle and check that vibration is below 2.5 mm/s.
 
Order no.
Description
Qty
BRG-7014-ACD
Spindle angular contact bearing 7014 ACD
2
SEAL-SPDL-70
Spindle front seal 70 mm
1
GREASE-KLB-2
Spindle bearing grease 400 g
1
4.2 Check spindle vibration from the HMI
Plant ref: PROC-CNC-02 | Lockout required: no | Time: 20 min
No isolation needed. Work from the HMI only.
1. Open Diagnostics, then Spindle, on the HMI and start the vibration test at 6000 rpm.
 2. Record the vibration reading and the bearing temperature.
 3. If vibration is above 2.5 mm/s or the temperature is above 65 C, plan PROC-CNC-01.
 4. Log the readings in the shift handover.
 Parts required: none.
4.3 Clean coolant filter and flush lines
Plant ref: PROC-CNC-03 | Lockout required: yes | Time: 45 min
WARNING: Apply lockout and tagout before starting. Verify zero energy.
1. Stop the coolant pump and apply lockout and tagout on the coolant pump breaker.
 2. Drain the filter housing into the waste tray.
 3. Replace the filter element with FLT-CL-25 and clean the housing.
 4. Flush the lines at low pressure for 5 minutes and check for leaks.
 5. Remove the lockout, restart the pump and confirm pressure above 18 bar.
 
Order no.
Description
Qty
FLT-CL-25
Coolant filter element 25 micron
1
Kessler Werkzeugmaschinen KX-500 Operator and Maintenance Manual, Revision 3
Page 5


4.4 Replace tool clamp disc springs
Plant ref: PROC-CNC-04 | Lockout required: yes | Time: 120 min
WARNING: Apply lockout and tagout before starting. Verify zero energy.
1. Stop the machine, apply lockout and tagout, and release air pressure to the tool changer.
 2. Remove the drawbar assembly from the spindle.
 3. Replace the disc spring stack with SPR-TC-40.
 4. Replace the clamp confirmation sensor SENS-PROX-08 and set its gap to 0.8 mm.
 5. Refit the drawbar and confirm a clamping force above 18 kN with the test gauge.
 
Order no.
Description
Qty
SPR-TC-40
Tool clamp disc spring set
1
SENS-PROX-08
Inductive proximity sensor M8
1
Kessler Werkzeugmaschinen KX-500 Operator and Maintenance Manual, Revision 3
Page 6
